notices: This form must be filled out by all travelers, whether Cuban or foreign, who enter to the Republic of Cuba through Airports.

All passengers are warned about the obligation to complete their forms 48 hours in advance.  The Airlines that operate in Cuba will verify the completion of your form before boarding your flight in print or on your mobile device.  In the event that you board the aircraft without completing your form, you will have to complete it at the airport of origin, thus making the travel experience difficult.
The form can be filled out from 72 hours before your arrival in the Republic of Cuba, until the moment before going through Immigration.

The QR code will be required for passengers to enter the Republic of Cuba when passing through the Sanitary and Customs authorities; this code is the one that validates that the form has been filled out correctly.

This single form replaces the three forms currently required: International Boarding and Disembarkation Card, Customs Declaration Form, and Traveler's Health Affidavit. Now all this information is in one single form.
If you are traveling as a family, you must fill out a form for each member of the family who is traveling.
For children, an individual form must also be filled out with all the required information.
Yes, the form must be filled out for each trip.
